items.text: 19SOLIDS,LIQUIDSANDGASES

items.label: text
items.text: All matter is made up of particles that are continuously moving. Thearrangement and movement of the particles determine theproperties of the material.In gases,scientists have discovered laws that describe the relationship between pressure,temperature and volume.In this chapter,you will learn what these lawsare and how this relationship can be explained in termsof thebehaviour of theparticles.

items.label: list_item
items.text: Figure 19.1The botanist Robert Brown (1773-1858)made anobservation whie studying polien grains under amicroscope that has become known as Brownian mobon in his honour.The observation led to the kinetic theory of matter that we use to explain the behaviour of solids,liquids and gases.
